CL_RBGAOBD2019.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Annual reminder not to offer gifts or advantages to BD officers.
每年提示不得向屋宇署人員送禮。

Publication of the **Code of Practice on Wind Effects in Hong Kong 2019**, usable at once, from a BD consultancy reviewing the **2004 Code** against international codes. New features: unified **gust pressure** approach with size and size-and-dynamic factors; **torsional and across-wind** forces; load combination factors; **building acceleration and occupant comfort**; wind loads on **temporary structures**; **sheltering** by effective height; force and pressure coefficients; wind tunnel guidance; **directionality factors**; dominant openings; damping by aspect ratio. **Explanatory Notes** issued too.
頒布**《2019 年香港風力效應作業守則》**，即時可用。新特點：統一**陣風壓**方法及尺寸、動力系數；**扭轉及橫風**；荷載組合；**建築物加速度及舒適度**；**臨時構築物**；以有效高度計**遮擋**；力及壓力系數；風洞測試；**風向系數**；主要開口；阻尼比；另附**釋義**。
**12-month grace period** for plans designed to the 2004 Code (later extended to 31 Mar 2021).
按 2004 年守則設計的圖則有 **12 個月寬限期**（其後延至 2021 年 3 月 31 日）。
CL_WC2019.status_note: Promulgates the current Wind Code 2019; grace period ended 31 Mar 2021 頒布現行風力守則；寬限期已結束

points: Repairs to damaged **curtain walls, glass walls and cladding** are **not** minor works or exempted works – they need **approval and consent**, but get **ADM-19 fast track (≤ 30 days)** if the structural system is unchanged. Follow **APP-117**, **APP-37** and **APP-16**; the RSE assesses existing condition and integrity. Replacing individual components (glass panes, sealants, setting blocks) or cladding panels to the approved design needs **no structural calculations** or parent-structure check.
修葺受損**幕牆、玻璃牆及覆面**不屬小型工程或豁免工程，須**批准及同意**；如結構系統不變可按 **ADM-19 快速處理（≤ 30 日）**；須符合 APP-117、APP-37、APP-16。按原設計更換個別組件毋須結構計算。

Submit together: (a) **supervision plan** (AP, RSE, RGBC per TM and Site Supervision Code); (b) for **tempered glass**, RSE/RGBC quality supervision plan for **heat soak** and the manufacturer's QA scheme (APP-37); (c) if glass thermal performance is worse than approved, provisional **OTTV** report (APP-67) and energy efficiency report (APP-156).
須同時提交：(a) **監工計劃書**；(b) 如用**鋼化玻璃**，熱浸品質監督計劃及廠商品質保證計劃；(c) 如玻璃隔熱較差，臨時 **OTTV** 報告（APP-67）及能源效益報告（APP-156）。
CL_CGWCR2019.status_note: In force (supersedes the Sep 2018 curtain wall letter) 有效（取代 2018 年 9 月通告）

points: Promulgates the advisory **Code of Practice on Design for Safety – External Maintenance** (means of access for maintenance of external walls, curtain walls, cladding, roofs and projections). Its **Appendix C** superseded the 23 Dec 2016 design guidelines for new and major revision plans submitted **on or after 1 Dec 2019**. BD planned performance-based requirements in regulations (now B(P)R and the 2021 AfEM Code).
頒布建議性質的**《設計安全作業守則 – 外部維修》**（外牆、幕牆、覆面、天台及伸出物的維修通道）；附錄 C 取代 2016 年 12 月 23 日的設計指引，適用於 2019 年 12 月 1 日或以後呈交的圖則；其後由規例及 2021 年守則取代。
CL_COPDSEM2019.status_note: Superseded by the Code of Practice on Access for External Maintenance 2021 已由 2021 年外部維修通道守則取代

points: From **1 Sep 2019**, new forms **UBW-1a and UBW-2a** let an AP/RSE certify food premises free of UBW **and validate unauthorised signboards** under the **Signboard Validation Scheme** at the same time when applying for an FEHD **food business licence**. Eligible signboards: para 6 of Annex I in App. P of the FEHD restaurant licence guide and B(MW)R Sch. 3 Part 3. See **APP-155**.
由 **2019 年 9 月 1 日**起，申請**食物業牌照**時可用新表格 **UBW-1a 及 UBW-2a**，同時證明處所無違例建築及**檢核違例招牌**（**招牌檢核計劃**，APP-155）。

**Vertical greening (VG)** – demountable modular units on a supporting frame on an external wall – must be shown on **GBP**. If the supporting frame is **> 3 m** above adjoining ground, **structural plans** are required (frame layout, fixing of modules).
**垂直綠化**須在一般建築圖則顯示；支承架高出地面 **> 3 米**須提交**結構圖則**。

**No structural details of modules** needed if: (a) each module **≤ 0.75 m** high and wide; (b) projection **≤ 0.2 m** from fixing points; (c) top **≤ 15 m** above ground; (d) proprietary system. AP/RSE still ensure safety; advise owners of **regular inspection and maintenance**.
如符合以下條件毋須提交組件結構細節：(a) 每件 **≤ 0.75 米**；(b) 伸出 **≤ 0.2 米**；(c) 最高點 **≤ 15 米**；(d) 專利系統。須提醒業主**定期檢查保養**。
